A contact point tells Grafana where to send notifications, like email, Slack, or PagerDuty.

In this milestone, you pick the contact point that receives notifications when this rule fires.

In the **Configure notifications** section, open the **Contact point** picker and choose **grafana-default-email**. Every Grafana Cloud stack includes it, and it delivers notifications to the email on your account.
Your rule now knows where to send notifications. Next, you write the notification message and save the rule.
